lcc_original: 於是女人見那棵樹的果子做食品似乎好喫，又悅人眼目，而且可喜愛、能使人有智慧，就摘取那果子來喫了；又給她丈夫一齊喫，她丈夫也喫了。
notes: LCC restructures the first clause as '做食品似乎好喫' (food/seemingly-good-to-eat) vs UNV '果子好作食物'; WAH09001+WH03978 anchored to 做食品, WH02896 anchored to 好.
{<WAH03588>} (כִּי 'that') kept implicit after 見 — LCC has no explicit connective particle before the object clause.
{<WH01931>} (הוּא 'it') kept implicit before 又 — no explicit subject pronoun in LCC.
{<WH06086>} (הָעֵץ 'the tree') kept implicit before 而且 — LCC does not restate the subject for the third clause.

WAH05973 (עִמָּהּ 'with her') mapped to 一齊 (together) — LCC reformulates as 'gave husband to eat together'; WH0398+WTH8799 for the husband's eating anchored to 她丈夫也喫了 (the explicit eating statement) rather than the complement 喫 in 一齊喫 (which functions as an infinitive complement of 給).
